name: Short Oval Extreme
detailed_description:
Short Oval Extreme is the definitive video game experience for fans of UK short oval racing, bringing the fast-paced, full-contact excitement of the real sport to life like never before. Launching with the legendary BriSCA Formula 1 Stock Cars, this game captures the roar of V8 power, the chaos of bumper-to-bumper action, and the adrenaline of racing wheel-to-wheel on tight oval tracks.

Take on the challenge across real-world UK circuits faithfully recreated in stunning detail – from the shale of Kings Lynn to the tarmac of Skegness, and the historic bends of Northampton, Belle Vue, and more. Every track has its own character, every surface affects your grip and handling, and every race is a battle.

Climb the ranks in an immersive career mode, starting as a novice white top and working your way up to the coveted gold roof. Manage your car’s setup, deal with damage, and outwit your rivals in a sport where contact isn't just allowed – it's expected.

Key Features:

  • 🏁 Authentic Short Oval Racing: Race on accurately recreated tarmac and shale tracks across the UK and Netherlands.

  • 🌦️ Dynamic Weather & Time of Day: Compete in changing conditions taken real time from the tracks location that challenge your control and strategy.

  • 🎮 Force Feedback & Wheel Support: Full steering wheel compatibility with force feedback for immersive realism.

  • 👻 Ghost System: Race against your best laps and learn from others to shave off crucial seconds.

  • 🎥 Replay System: Relive the action from any angle and capture your best (or worst) moments.

Whether you're chasing glory in a championship, battling elbows-out in a Banger race, or honing your hot lap under the floodlights, Short Oval Extreme delivers the ultimate oval racing experience.

  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 or similar
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: 2.0Ghz Quad Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
